goldset.held_out: Sampled independently of our own coverage. No pass saw our database, our stored rows or our collector list, and no pass could cite an aggregator, a deal database or another tracker.
caveats: Most countries carry only a few events, so a single country cell is an indication and not a rate; the country table is a work list.
The population is the EU27 plus the United Kingdom, Switzerland and Norway, by headquarters. Turkey, Ukraine, the western Balkans and the Caucasus are not in it.
This measures two of the four kinds of signal the tracker collects, funding rounds and leadership changes. Pay and ways-of-working signals are not tested here.
Every row was accepted by two AI referees reading a fetched excerpt, not by a person. The labels file keeps every verdict.

Rows a pass verified but which refused a second, mechanical fetch from this machine were dropped as unreachable and are listed in the file, so countries whose press blocks fetchers are under-represented.
Funding events with amount_disclosed=false carry no figure because the publisher stated none.
